title: CRM for the agent
description: Choose the Bitrix24 fields the agent can read and explain what each one means for your business.
off: Agent access to the CRM is not available yet.
readOnly: You can view these settings. To change them, ask an administrator for access.
refreshUnavailable: Bitrix24 did not respond right now. The fields below are from the last read; try again in a moment.

choose.title: Choose the fields
choose.text: Only the fields added here reach the agent. The rest of Bitrix24 stays invisible to it.

explain.title: Explain what they mean
explain.text: The description tells the agent how to interpret the field in your business.

usage.contact: The agent uses these fields to identify the customer in the conversation.
usage.deal: The agent reads these fields on the customer deals (up to 10, from newest to oldest).
usage.lead: Used when the conversation is linked to a lead and there is no contact yet.
usage.company: Used when the conversation is linked only to a company.

reads: {count, plural, one {The agent reads # field} other {The agent reads # fields}} from {entity}.
noFields: The agent does not read any {entity} fields yet.
allAdded: All fields have already been added

preview.title: What the agent receives
preview.note: Example with fictional values, not a real customer.
preview.none: The agent does not receive any {entity} data.

badges.missing: No longer exists in the portal

descriptionPlaceholder: E.g.: "Plan contracted by the customer; Gold includes 24h support"
noDescription: No description: explain what this field means in your business.
addFailed: {count, plural, one {Could not add # field. It stays selected; try again.} other {Could not add # fields. They stay selected; try again.}}

modal.title: Add {entity} fields
modal.description: Select the fields in your Bitrix24 that the agent can read.
modal.searchPlaceholder: Search by field name or code
modal.note: After adding, describe what each field means in your business. Phone and email are personal data: add them only if the agent really needs them.
modal.allAdded: All fields have already been added.
modal.noResults: No fields found for this search.

errors.load: Could not load the CRM fields.
errors.refresh: Could not refresh from Bitrix24. Please try again.
errors.saveField: Could not save this field. Please try again.
errors.CRM_UNAVAILABLE: Bitrix24 did not respond right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CRM_ACCESS_BUSY: Another change to this agent CRM access is in progress. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.CRM_FIELD_NOT_FOUND: Field not found in the CRM
